title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘Sand’ complements its molded one-piece construction with an understated light tan finish. Built with EVA foam, the upper features sculpted lines and a series of mapped vents throughout the midfoot and vamp for enhanced breathability. A textured footbed keeps the foot locked in place, while the contoured outsole utilizes a wavy traction pattern for optimal grip. An adidas logo is stamped under the heel.

title: YEEZY QUANTUM
description: The adidas Yeezy Quantum 'Flash Orange' carries a breathable jacquard mesh upper with wavy overlays in contrasting black and burnt orange accents. The mid-top is equipped with a stretchy neoprene collar and fortified with a synthetic suede toe cap. A seamless heel counter extends to the midsole, packed with full-length Boost cushioning wrapped in a semi-translucent rubber cage. Underfoot, the rubber outsole features a classic herringbone tread for stop-and-go traction.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Onyx’ applies a stealthy palette to the lifestyle silhouette that merges Kanye West’s visionary aesthetic with adidas’ performance technology. The sneaker makes use of a one-note black Primeknit upper, secured with rope laces and equipped with a pull tab at the heel. On the lateral side, a post-dyed monofilament stripe adds a see-through element to the sock-like build. A full-length Boost midsole is surrounded by a ribbed, semi-translucent TPU cage that maintains the shoe’s monochrome design.

title: YEEZY SLIDES KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Slide Kids ‘Flax’ applies a monochrome dark beige hue to a molded one-piece build made with injected EVA foam. Open-toe construction provides improved airflow, while strategically placed grooves on the outsole deliver a combination of traction and shock absorption. Exterior branding is limited to a discreet adidas logo on the footbed, featuring a soft top layer that offers immediate step-in comfort.

title: YEEZY KNIT RUNNER
description: The adidas Yeezy Knit Runner ‘Fade Indigo’ brings a gradient color scheme to the minimalist slip-on. Built with knit textile, the upper is rendered in an ombre effect made up of blue, green, and violet hues. A solid blue finish distinguishes the stretchy cuff that accentuates the sneaker’s snug, sock-like fit. Lightweight cushioning is provided by a hidden EVA misdsole. Underfoot, adidas branding decorates the brown rubber outsole, featuring a modified herringbone tread for superior grip.
